review.reason: The mapped course layout, hazards, connectors, tees, greens and lake are represented clearly. The small vertical fairway section for Hole 1 reads as a checkerboard rather than clearly visible transverse mowing stripes.

issues.detail: The vertical fairway patch left of the lake has a checkerboard pattern instead of distinct alternating bands crossing the fairway edge-to-edge, perpendicular to its local direction of play.
issues.consequence: At overview scale, this patch does not read as striped fairway and is visually inconsistent with the other fairway sections.
